observation.visible_scene: A mountain waterfall pours from a rocky ledge into a turquoise pool, set between steep grey rock walls covered in green moss, grass patches and conifer trees. In the foreground a fast stream rushes over rounded brown boulders, generating white frothy rapids. A small green text watermark reading 'Healing Nature & Meditation' is overlaid on the right-hand rock face throughout.
visible_changes: The waterfall's white cascade and the splash/spray at its base continuously change shape from frame to frame, indicating ongoing turbulent flow rather than a start or stop.
The foreground rapids churn and the foam patterns over the rocks shift and reform, showing the stream moving downstream toward the viewer.
The pool surface shows small ripples and reflections that vary slightly.
The rocks, cliffs, trees and the text watermark keep identical positions across all frames, so the camera is stationary (no pan, tilt or zoom); the only motion is the flowing water.
outside_clip_unknowns: The upstream source feeding the waterfall and the downstream continuation of the stream are not shown.
Any sound or wind effects on the foliage are unknown.
uncertain_details: Whether there is any sub-pixel camera drift is unclear; background edges look fixed, suggesting none.
Exact flow rate or water volume cannot be judged from the images.
